trigger: Each accepted mapping row requests work while raw and private canonical file versions remain unchanged.
observedCode: Scratch directory creation and complete written-mapping copy occur before both media-version no-op checks.
amplification: If each worker iteration finishes before the next callback, written observation prefixes are recopied once per frame: quadratic cumulative mapping bytes. At 4,428 frames and about 4 MiB final observations the upper estimate is about 9 GiB of writes, before coalescing; longer legitimate takes grow this cost. This is a code-derived upper estimate, not a runtime I/O measurement.
correction: Check raw/canonical versions and pending mapping eligibility before creating scratch or copying observations. Preserve file-event catch-up and written-row eligibility changes.
acceptance: A tiny production consumer must preserve exact live/final output and demonstrate bounded/no-op snapshot work for an unchanged media interval; then use one retained-take measurement.
disposition: Resolved in the measured candidate: cheap eligibility checks precede scratch creation; written mapping snapshots reuse owned COW cloning and truncate only the private clone to the written byte boundary.

relatedSchedulingFinding.trigger: A file event reads the old lastWritten tuple, ingress records a newer tuple, then the event calls request with its stale tuple.
relatedSchedulingFinding.impact: Unconditional assignment can regress lastWritten and pending. After the final callback, later file notifications can keep waking an old boundary, increasing final-tail work. Complete closed-source verification still protects publication.
relatedSchedulingFinding.acceptance: Written byte boundary never regresses; even a stale notification schedules the current newest boundary. Preserve equal-boundary file-event catch-up.
relatedSchedulingFinding.disposition: Resolved in the measured candidate: request selects the greatest written byte boundary under its existing control lock, and stale/equal notifications still enqueue that current boundary.

replayRed.limit: The initial catch-up burst is directly recorded; one backpressure refusal occurred. No global load or scheduler cause is inferred.

measurement.scope: Native-rate prerecorded screen/camera replay; microphone disabled; no AppKit quit timer or physical devices

replayGreen.limit: 32x16 prerecorded fixture only; no retained-take or physical-device deadline claim.
